_: The buyer's install-to-play steps, one copy. tools/installer/sync_steps.py writes them into the download page, plugin page, key email (worker/license/steps.js), Mac installer's last screen, Windows installer's Finished page and install.sh. Markup: **bold**, `code`.
mac: Double-click **Infinite.pkg**. macOS says it cannot check it: click **Done**.
Open **System Settings › Privacy & Security**, scroll down and click **Open Anyway** next to Infinite.pkg.
In the installer, read the Welcome and Terms, then tick what to add: **Infinite app**, **VST3**, **AU**. No admin password.
windows: Run **Infinite-Setup-windows-x64.exe**. If SmartScreen appears, click **More info**, then **Run anyway**.
Accept the terms and tick what to add: **Infinite app**, **VST3**. No admin rights needed.
If your DAW does not find Infinite, add `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Common\VST3` to its VST3 folders.
linux: Unpack it: `tar xzf Infinite-linux-x86_64.tar.gz`, then `cd Infinite-linux-x86_64`.
Run `./install.sh`. It asks what to add, no sudo. Remove it later with `./install.sh --uninstall`.
play: Open your DAW and rescan plugins.
Add **Infinite Instrument** to an instrument track, or **Infinite FX** to an audio track, and open it.
The licence screen opens. Copy the key from your email and click **Paste key**.
